candidates.title: Interactive Pet Selection Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the companion pick screen into a stage layout featuring live animated preview cards and quick selection options.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion (60.9%) and long decision time (89s median). Giving clearer live visual previews speeds up decision-making.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Choose a pet personality to live on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the pet choice screen that retains its functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the largest drop-off (60.9% conversion), but animated stage requires a full redesign.

candidates.title: Move Sign In After Pet Choice
candidates.change: Shift account creation to occur after pet selection so users establish emotional attachment before signing in.
candidates.why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users when placed right after path selection. Moving sign-in after picking a pet builds momentum.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your custom pet synced across devices.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated desktop controls guide screen before finishing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion around hiding, summoning, or interacting with pets once setup completes.

candidates.title: Visual Waiting Progress Ticker
candidates.change: Add an engaging progress tracker and interactive tips carousel to the waiting generation screen.
candidates.why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off if they think the app froze.

components.text: Press Alt+Pet to interact anytime on desktop

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen updates providing progress information and user tips.

candidates.score_note: Massive wait time (mean 2336s) causes drop-offs; ticker improves perceived waiting time.

candidates.title: Path Selector Split View Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into a side-by-side split visual card layout highlighting Instant vs Custom adoption.
candidates.why: Path choice drops 23.8% of users with an average duration of 514s, indicating confusion between pathways.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Adopt?
choose_path.body: Choose a pre-made companion or create a customized pet.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Account Sync Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit safeguard helper hint on the sign in screen clarifying account restoration.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different social account.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your primary email to keep all existing pets linked to your account.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Customizer Fallback Step
candidates.change: Add a fallback pet customizer preset flow before photo upload.
candidates.why: Support received reports of custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly from uploaded photos.

candidates.title: Direct Launch Call-to-Action
candidates.change: Update final screen button copy and headline to emphasize instant desktop activation.
candidates.why: Completion on the final screen drops to 64.8% with high mean delay, suggesting users don't realize setup is finished.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click below to summon your companion directly onto your desktop workspace.

guard.reason: Valid copy updates to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: High drop at final step (64.8%); copy change is cheap and highly direct.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Alert Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts and audio chime when pet asset rendering completes.
candidates.why: High waiting time (median 201s) leads users to background the window and abandon setup before seeing their pet.

guard.reason: Valid notification and sound additions for waiting screen completion.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users who background the browser during the 200s+ wait.

candidates.title: Streamlined Onboarding Story Copy
candidates.change: Simplify intro story text to clearly explain desktop pet capabilities in 3 brief points.
candidates.why: Choose path step shows a high mean time of 514s, indicating slow engagement with initial introduction text.

story.headline: Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion
story.body: Your pet lives on your desktop, interacts with your workflow, and keeps you company while you work.

guard.reason: Valid copy update to story screen that continues to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Quick copy edit for step 1; low cost though median time is already low (8s).
